content: NAP registry defines the runtime capability seam: mandatory shell handshake/supports, active intent/inc/theme, draft relay/identity/storage/keys/media/notify/resource/config/upload/value/outbox/link/pow and deferred connect/class. Web projection uses sandboxed allow-scripts iframes, postMessage envelopes, window.napplet domains, runtime-attested manifest identity, and strict policy mediation; napplets must not receive keys or raw network access.
